question: Do the 50 muzzle velocities EA lists in the 1.3.3.0 notes equal the stored registry defaults and own values?

sourceFacts.method: The 50 'from X m/s to Y m/s' lines were parsed from the saved notes text. Each EA weapon name was joined by name to a weapon file; the registry row '<weapon>_WB.WeaponEntityData.WeaponFiring.PrimaryFire.Shot.InitialSpeed.z' and the own value (Class_35259f6b.Field_0bf4f62b.Field_32a99b9c in the weapon file) were read and re-read at raw offsets.

control.description: 49 of 50 registry defaults equal EA's new figure exactly; a wrong name join would not produce an exact match.

l115.note: 0.8^n is the velocity tier factor recorded for barrels in FIELD_MAP.md

inference: The registry default holds EA's current muzzle velocity for 49 of the 50 weapons. Own values were read for 50 weapons: 49 equal EA's new figure and 0 EA's old figure.

The L115 is the exception: registry 742, EA 664. 742 x 0.8^0.5 = 663.7, which rounds to EA's 664; 0.8^n is the barrel velocity tier factor already in FIELD_MAP.md, so EA's L115 figure may be the velocity with its default barrel at half a tier. That is arithmetic, not a traced link.
The name joins are by name only (for example NVO-228E to ACE32, KV9 to Vector); each is supported by an exact velocity match.
unresolved: Why the L115 differs. Check: the L115's default barrel attachment and its velocity tier value; if it is 0.5 the figure is explained.
EA's 'Bullet Drag increased by 40%, 100% with Match Grade ammo' is not compared here.
siteImpact: None. No Analyzer data, simulation or UI change.

leads.title: EA's 1.3.3.0 muzzle velocity table against stored values: 49 of 50 registry defaults equal EA's new figure; the L115 stores 742 against EA's 664
leads.summary: EA's 1.3.3.0 notes list 50 muzzle velocities. The registry default equals EA's new figure for 49 of them. The exception is the L115: stored 742 m/s against EA's 664, and 742 x 0.8^0.5 = 663.7, which suggests EA quotes the L115 with a default barrel penalty. Own values: 50 read, 49 equal EA's new figure, 0 the old one. 100 raw-offset checks matched.
leads.reopenWhen: The L115 default barrel's velocity tier is read, or a new EA velocity table.
leads.statusNote: 49 of 50 exact; L115 explained only by arithmetic.
